CustomField.description: Which section(s) of the Intelligence panel a neighbour of this node type belongs under: Structure, Automation, Code, Security, or Data — semicolon-delimited when a type genuinely belongs under more than one (e.g. "Automation;Code" for Apex Trigger). Registry-driven rather than hardcoded in Apex or LWC, so introducing a new metadata type places it in the right section(s) with no code change (ADR-0011). Left blank means the type is only summarised generically and never gets its own section.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Structure, Automation, Code, Security, or Data — semicolon-delimited for more than one (e.g. "Automation;Code"). Controls which Intelligence panel section(s) this node type appears under.
CustomField.label: Intelligence Category
